title: Midnight Courier
logline: A courier on a red motorbike has 30 seconds to deliver a glowing package before the clock strikes twelve, with a black SUV on her tail.
times: playback seconds of the 30.00 s take. Slow motion runs 16.1-18.1 s (30 % speed from 16.45 to 17.75 s).

sound.what: engine idling, distant city hum, a clock ticking
